proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: No strict limit for basic usage, standard rate limits apply, completely free without credit card.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Converts any URL (including JS-rendered pages) into clean, LLM-friendly Markdown by simply prepending 'https://r.jina.ai/' to the URL.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Trend scouting step: GitHub Actions curls Google Trends or niche marketplace pages through Jina Reader and feeds the clean Markdown directly to Gemini to extract high-value keywords.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Some sites with heavy Cloudflare protection may block the Jina proxy.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 2,500 free search queries upon registration, no expiration.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Provides raw Google Search, Google Images, and Google Shopping results in structured JSON at a fraction of the cost of SerpApi.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Niche validation step: Automated scripts on GitHub Actions query Google Shopping/Images to verify demand and competition for proposed coloring book themes before generation.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Requires email registration to get the API key; once the 2,500 queries are exhausted, requires paid top-ups (though very cheap at $1 per 1,000 queries).

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Around $10 in free credits upon initial developer registration.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Hosts ultra-fast FLUX.1-schnell ($0.003/image) and specialized models like FLUX-LoRAs. Extremely developer-friendly with a lightweight Python SDK.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Coloring book generation pipeline: GitHub Actions calls the Fal.ai API to generate high-quality vector-ready line art using FLUX.1-schnell at less than a fraction of a cent per image.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Once free credits run out, requires a credit card to transition to a pay-as-you-go model (though costs remain extremely low).

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 100 free image generation credits refreshed daily.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Offers a solid API for Stable Diffusion XL, ControlNet, and custom models with a generous, recurring daily free tier that fits automated cron-jobs.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Daily POD asset pipeline: A GitHub Actions cron job runs daily, uses the 100 free credits to generate high-quality watercolor or graphic assets, and pushes them to Redbubble.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Rate limits on the free tier can cause temporary 429 errors if images are requested too rapidly in parallel.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 100% free to publish and sell digital 3D models (STLs/3MFs).
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Features a unique 'Prusameters' reward system where free downloads of your designs earn points redeemable for physical 3D printers and filament, alongside a direct Store feature.
proposals.would_integrate_where: 3D Asset Pipeline: Expand Cults3D strategy by cross-publishing parametric or decorative STL files to Printables, building passive traffic and earning physical rewards or direct sales.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Audience is highly tech-literate; models must be highly functional or aesthetically flawless to gain traction.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: No monthly fees. Standard transaction fee of 5% + $0.50 per sale.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Acts as the Merchant of Record (MoR), handling global sales tax, EU VAT (TVA in France), and compliance automatically. Extremely clean developer API.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Direct Sales Pipeline: Allows Hugo to host his own minimal catalog of digital coloring books, card game PDFs, or gamedev assets on a custom static site (hosted free on GitHub Pages) and accept payments legally without complex tax overhead.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Slightly higher transaction fees compared to Stripe, but saves dozens of hours in accounting and tax filing.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 25 Monthly Credits (approx. 25,000 transformations or 25 GB of storage/bandwidth).
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: An API-driven image management suite. Can auto-convert formats, apply real-time filters, resize, and optimize images via URL parameters instantly.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Asset optimization pipeline: After generating large raw images via AI, GitHub Actions uploads them to Cloudinary to automatically generate compressed WebP previews, watermarked thumbnails, and optimized print layouts.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Exceeding the credit limit will temporarily disable dynamic transformations until the monthly cycle resets.
